results.content: # Minneapolis crews dismantle barriers around Renee Good memorial, educators urge ICE to "stay away from schools". Educators with Minneapolis called on federal agents to stay away from school property following reports of ICE agents tackling people on the grounds of Roosevelt High School on Wednesday, hours after Good's killing. Several Minneapolis, Hennepin County and state leaders gathered Friday morning at Minneapolis City Hall in a joint call for President Trump's FBI to bring the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension into the fold for the investigation into the killing of Renee Good. Minneapolis city crews began dismantling the makeshift barriers near Renee Good's memorial off Portland Avenue and East 34th Street on Friday around 4 a.m. Several police squad vehicles, officers and SWAT team members are also at the scene.
